title: Whale dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- water splash background hints -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='85' rx='38' ry='7' fill='#1b6ca8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='85' rx='30' ry='4' fill='#2ea8e0'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='55' rx='30' ry='22' fill='#2e9bd6'/>
  <!-- belly lighter -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='63' rx='22' ry='13' fill='#a8e0f5'/>
  <!-- tail flipping up -->
  <path d='M76 44 Q88 30 84 18 Q78 26 74 30 Q72 24 66 20 Q66 32 70 42 Z' fill='#1d6fa8'/>
  <path d='M76 44 Q84 34 82 24 Q78 30 76 34 Z' fill='#4cc4ef'/>
  <!-- dorsal fin -->
  <path d='M46 34 Q50 24 58 32 Q52 34 48 34 Z' fill='#1d6fa8'/>
  <!-- side fin dancing -->
  <path d='M28 58 Q16 60 12 52 Q20 52 27 54 Z' fill='#4cc4ef'/>
  <!-- other fin up -->
  <path d='M34 46 Q26 36 30 28 Q34 36 38 42 Z' fill='#4cc4ef'/>
  <!-- head bump -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='48' rx='14' ry='13' fill='#2e9bd6'/>
  <!-- mouth smile -->
  <path d='M18 54 Q26 60 36 56' stroke='#1d6fa8' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='45' r='3.5' fill='#0d3d5c'/>
  <circle cx='26.3' cy='43.8' r='1.3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='52' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <g fill='#ffd94a'>
    <circle cx='70' cy='22' r='3'/>
    <rect x='72' y='10' width='1.8' height='12'/>
    <path d='M72 10 Q78 11 78 15 Q75 13 72 13 Z'/>
    <circle cx='86' cy='34' r='2.6'/>
    <rect x='87.6' y='24' width='1.6' height='10'/>
    <path d='M87.6 24 Q93 25 93 28 Q90 26.5 87.6 26.6 Z'/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe98a'>
    <path d='M14 26 l2 4 l4 1 l-4 1 l-2 4 l-1 -4 l-4 -1 l4 -1 Z'/>
    <path d='M60 14 l1.5 3 l3 0.8 l-3 0.8 l-1.5 3 l-1.5 -3 l-3 -0.8 l3 -0.8 Z'/>
  </g>
</svg>
